responsibility: This definition module declares the REAL-oriented elementary math interface for GNU Modula-2 and exports constants such as pi and exp1. It belongs to the numeric runtime library layer and provides the public procedures for square root, exponential, logarithmic, trigonometric, arctangent, and integer-part operations on REAL values, distinct from the LONGREAL-specific LMathLib0 companion.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition half of the MathLib0 pair: it publishes only the REAL-based math interface and constants. Unlike gcc/m2/gm2-libs/MathLib0.mod, it does not contain the cbuiltin/libm-backed procedure bodies or the internal SHORTREAL/LONGREAL helper variants present in the implementation.
